title: Finite section scalar transport data
statement: For finite commutative rings A and B, a unital map φ:A→B, an annihilator N>0 of A which is invertible on S, and the actual smooth Rees section geometry, the coefficient section maps for g and its deformation projection are isomorphisms and satisfy the canonical one and zero fibre scalar/base-change squares.

proof.text: Apply the finite exceptional coefficient comparison to the actual smooth Rees projection and its section to obtain that the two coefficient section maps are invertible. Apply the section scalar/base-change theorem to the one and zero fibre pullback squares of the Rees family; its two resulting equations are exactly FibreCompatibility. The image of N in B is zero by the ring map, and all compactification and quasi-compactness instances are supplied by the actual finite-ring section geometry.

mathlib_searches.results: Existing declarations provide the section scalar/base-change theorem and the actual finite-ring geometry; no public theorem packages the coefficient-map isomorphisms with both fibre squares.
